decisions.quote:
We find substantial sensitivity to the selection of covariates in
the additional specifications we present in which continent fixed e↵ects are the only covariates in
Tables 2 and 3 using the original Ashraf and Galor data, let alone the addition of the Wang et al.
data.
decisions.reason: The study re-analyses Ashraf and Galor's (2013) original dataset and code to reproduce the reported regressions, test alternative covariate specifications, and fix software coding errors, while also extending the dataset with additional archival sources.

decisions.quote:
The last component of our analysis uncovers a coding error present in the original paper. Ashraf
and Galor fail to include the appropriate number of fixed e↵ects. When corrected, the conclusions of
their analysis regarding the mechanisms through which genetic diversity a↵ects economic development
no longer hold; according to their specifications, there seems to be no evidence that the two competing
mechanisms of the genetic diversity channel are operating simultaneously in the same set of countries.
decisions.reason: The authors exactly reproduce the original regression results across tables (e.g., Table 2 Column 1, Table 3 Column 1, Table 4 Column 1, and Table 5 Columns 1 and 3), but show that the findings on the original data do not survive restricting covariates to continent fixed effects or correcting the omitted legal-origin dummy coding error.
